simulation_boundaries: Replay mode bypasses persona compilation and dispatches a declared instruction trajectory directly.
Trajectory args are supplied inline per event; generic adapters may still fall back to adapter literals for unmapped constants.
initial-state.json, when present, is applied as a pre-tick bootstrap instruction list before tick 0 is recorded.
Agent balance/PnL fields are bookkeeping-only in replay mode; authoritative outputs are primitive snapshots, events, and invariant rollups.
what_this_proof_does_not_claim: a byte-level reproduction of Mango v3's program or the slot state from the October 2022 exploit,
an audit or safety claim about Mango Markets, Mango v3, or any deployed Solana perpetual-trading protocol,

a faithful model of multi-source TWAP oracle composition or order-book-driven price discovery -- the toy fixture realizes the pump and revert as two single-tick price moves rather than as a structural matching-engine reaction.
